title: 第23章 修仙界诈骗犯第24章 没法像从前那般信任
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: “对对对！郑常小友，你这给我们提供了献门的重要情报，确实功劳不小啊。”
是啊，功劳大到郑常自己都不知道是啥。
“城主客气了，都是我应该做的。我师父也时常教育我修行不要忘记为正道做出贡献。”郑常鬼扯道。。
“噢？不知道小友的师尊是……”
“抱歉城主，师父不让我透露他的身份，他怕我借助他的身份狐假虎威。”
“是我唐突了，尊师品德高尚，秦某佩服啊。”
“唉，实不相瞒，其实师父还没正式收下我，他说要考验我，只传给我功法，说只有等我凑齐了除了风龙鳞以外的风灵根完美特殊筑基材料，才正式收我为徒，助我完美特殊筑基。”
风灵根完美特殊筑基，除了风龙鳞以外的材料，传地阶中品的风龙族持有的功法残卷。
郑常字字不提风龙，却句句不离风龙。
“原来如此，怪不得小友会到那荒无人烟的悬空山，我记得风灵根的特殊筑基，是需要浮空石的，对吧？”
“正是，师父让我收集材料，想必是存了历练我的心思，我正好路过悬空山，便去收集材料顺便感悟一番。”
“也是小友刚好路过悬空山，才能为我们提供献门的情报，”
秦铁心正说着呢，突然做出了个夸张的恍然大悟表情道。
“啊！我正愁不知道给小友你什么奖励呢。你说你要特殊筑基我倒是想起来了。城主仓库里有一株凤息兰，一块青萍琥珀石，正好都是风灵根特殊筑基的材料，就拿来给你当奖励了，小友你看如何？”
郑常扫了一眼系统的表格。
凤息兰，两千下品灵石。
青萍琥珀石，一千三百下品灵石。
两个加起来，都三千三了，这秦城主够狠心下血本的啊！
虽然郑常的本意就是想忽悠点材料，但他没想要这么贵的啊。第一次搞诈骗，金额弄太大，他有点怂。
要是让秦铁心知道自己是忽悠他的，不得追杀自己到天涯海角？
“秦城主，您说的东西太贵重了，师父让我寻找材料必然是要考验我的。若是便宜的材料就罢了，您把这般把贵重的给我，我怕师父责怪。”
郑常说这话时，着重说了“贵重”和“便宜”两个词，希望对方能明白自己的暗示，给点便宜点的材料打发走自己就好。
秦铁心听出来了。
给少了。
唉，风龙族强者看中的弟子，怎么靠三四千灵石的材料就打发了呢。
刚刚巡城城卫和他报告了，这郑常来到晏城后，第一天住了有聚灵阵的房间。之后的三天都是住普通客栈的上等房间。
而他这炼气六层却是在住进普通客房的时候突破的。
这说明什么？说明他在普通客房也有在修炼。
那他为什么不在聚灵阵房间里修炼，偏要在普通客房修炼呢？
总不能是聚灵阵里灵气吸收得撑得慌吧？人家可是风灵根。
那就只有一种可能了。对这个郑常来说，在聚灵阵里和不在聚灵阵里，他每日都能将灵气吸收到满溢状态！
郑常每天都是直接吸收灵石修炼的！
是了，他能一个月不到突破到炼气六层，也只有这一种可能的。
content_en:
"Yes, yes! Little friend Zheng Chang, you have indeed done a great job in providing us with important information about Xianmen."
Yes, the credit was so great that Zheng Chang himself didn’t even know what it was.
"The city lord is so polite. This is what I should do. My master also always teaches me to practice and not forget to contribute to the righteous path." Zheng Chang said nonchalantly. .
"Oh? I don't know who my little friend's master is..."
"I'm sorry, City Lord. Master won't let me reveal his identity. He's afraid that I'll use his identity to pretend to be powerful."
"I was the one who was rude. I respect your teacher's noble moral character. Qin admires me."
"Well, to be honest, master hasn't officially accepted me yet. He said he would test me and only teach me the techniques. He said that he would only officially accept me as his disciple after I gather all the perfect special foundation-building materials for wind spirit roots except the wind dragon scales to help me perfect the special foundation-building."
The wind spirit root is a perfect special foundation, with materials other than wind dragon scales, and a residual scroll of the skill held by the mid-level wind dragon tribe.
Zheng Chang did not mention Fenglong in any word, but he never mentioned Fenglong.
"I see. No wonder my friend went to the deserted Hanging Mountain. I remember that the special foundation building of Fenglinggen requires floating stones, right?"
"Exactly, Master asked me to collect materials, presumably with the intention of training me. I happened to pass by Xuankong Mountain, so I went to collect the materials and gain some insights."
"It was only because my friend happened to pass by Xuankong Mountain that he could provide us with the information about Xianmen,"
As Qin Tiexin was talking, he suddenly made an exaggerated expression of realization.
"Ah! I was worried about what reward to give you, little friend. You said you wanted to build a special foundation, but I remembered it. There is a Phoenix Orchid and a piece of green amber stone in the city lord's warehouse, which happen to be the materials for the special foundation building of Fenglinggen, so I gave them to you as a reward. What do you think, little friend?"
Zheng Chang glanced at the system's form.
Fengxilan, two thousand low-grade spiritual stones.
Qingping amber stone, one thousand three hundred low-grade spiritual stones.
The two together are three thousand and three. This City Lord Qin is so cruel and spends so much money!
Although Zheng Chang's original intention was to fool around with some materials, he didn't want something so expensive. It was his first time to engage in fraud, and the amount was too high, which made him a little timid.
If Qin Tiexin knew that she was fooling him, wouldn't he be allowed to chase him to the ends of the earth?
"City Master Qin, the things you mentioned are too valuable. Master asked me to find the materials to test me. If they are cheap materials, that's all. If you give me something valuable like this, I'm afraid Master will blame you."
When Zheng Chang said this, he emphasized the words "expensive" and "cheap", hoping that the other party would understand his hint and just give him some cheaper materials to send him away.
Qin Tiexin heard it.
Give less.
Alas, how could the disciple who was favored by the strong man of the Wind Dragon Clan be dismissed with just three or four thousand spirit stones?
The city guard who patrolled the city just reported to him that Zheng Chang stayed in a room with a spirit gathering array on his first day after arriving in Yancheng. For the next three days, I stayed in a superior room in an ordinary hotel.
However, he broke through the sixth level of Qi Refining while staying in an ordinary guest room.
What does this mean? It shows that he is also practicing in the ordinary guest room.
Then why didn't he practice in the Spirit Gathering Array room instead of practicing in an ordinary guest room?
It can't be that the spiritual energy in the spirit gathering array has been absorbed to the point of panic, right? He is a wind spirit root.
Then there is only one possibility. For Zheng Chang, whether in the Spirit Gathering Array or not, he can absorb the spiritual energy to a full state every day!
Zheng Chang directly absorbs spirit stones to practice every day!
Yes, it was only possible that he could break through to the sixth level of Qi Refining in less than a month.
